[ASSISTANT_SAID] 1. Start with a base fitness level of at least 3-4 months of regular running.

[ASSISTANT_SAID] - Speed intervals (200-800m) at high intensity with active recovery.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] - Hill repeats at high intensity.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] - Fartlek (speed play) with alternating fast and slow segments.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] - Tempo intervals (1-2 miles) at moderate to high intensity.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 3. Incorporate interval workouts 1-2 times a week.
